faq.question: Q1. What is the walk-in interview date for SBC Exports Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The dates depend on the post: 11.11.2026, 19.11.2026, 20.11.2026, 23.11.2026, 01.12.2026, 02.12.2026 and 04.12.2026. The first is Technician (Microbiology) on Wednesday, 11.11.2026, and the last is Pharmacist on Friday, 04.12.2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Candidates report between 09.00 am and 10.00 am at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) – 842004.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 16 vacancies across 10 posts. Technician (OT/ICU) has the most with 4; Technician (Microbiology), Technician (Haematology) and Technician (Phlebotomist) have 2 each; the other posts have 1 each.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Pharmacist post?
faq.answer: A Diploma in Pharmacy with pharmacist registration and two years experience as pharmacist, OR a B. Pharm with pharmacist registration under the Pharmacy act 1948 and one year experience as pharmacist.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 27 years for the Technician posts (Microbiology, Biochemistry, Haematology, Phlebotomist, OT/ICU), 30 years for Scientific Officer (Microbiology), Dialysis Technician, Scientific Assistant (CSSD) and Pharmacist, and 35 years for Scientific Officer (Programmer), as on the walk-in interview date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: Monthly remuneration is Rs. 20,644/- for the technician posts and Dialysis Technician, Rs. 35,000/- for both Scientific Officer posts, Rs. 30,000/- for Scientific Assistant (CSSD) and Rs. 24,258/- for Pharmacist.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I carry?
faq.answer: Carry Bio-data, a recent passport size photograph, PAN Card, Aadhar Card, and Educational and Experience Certificates in original with one set of self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: If more candidates attend, an MCQ Test will be conducted and eligible candidates will be shortlisted for the interview accordingly.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on contract basis through M/s. SBC Exports Ltd., an outsourcing agency. The appointment is initially for six months and extendable, if required.

faq.question: Q10. Will accommodation be provided to outstation candidates?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates.
